title: Plus One
logline: At the wedding of the friend who stole her fiancé, Nora's hired date turns out to be the bride's jilted ex, and he did not pick Nora by chance.

hook.image: Extreme close-up: Nora's eyes over a champagne flute; a man's lips at her ear.
hook.text: SHE HIRED HIM FOR ONE NIGHT.

sheet.recap: She married my fiancé. Tonight, you're mine.
sheet.want: Nora wants to look untouchable at Celeste's wedding.
sheet.obstacle: Her hired date knows the bride.
sheet.twist: Theo was supposed to marry Celeste: the prop has his own war.
sheet.choice: Nora kisses Theo in front of Celeste.
sheet.cost: She gives up the safe, polite plan and lets a stranger into her revenge.
sheet.payoff: The ex was watching, and Celeste is the one who breaks first.

cliffhanger.last_frame: Extreme close-up of Nora, string-light bokeh, holding Theo's gaze after: "I didn't answer your ad by accident."

closed: Will Nora survive the wedding with her dignity?

beats.change: forbidden line in the first second, hook text
recap line states the stakes, comic bet
the bride arrives and knows the date
new fact: he was going to marry her
new fact, held look, hard cut

look.style: Cinematic 35 mm film look of a premium streaming romantic comedy, photoreal people, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh
look.lighting: warm tungsten string lights and table candles as the key, cool deep-blue night through the glass walls as rim and fill, soft falloff on faces, the same light direction in every shot
look.camera: intimate, on sticks with a slight breathing handheld drift, motivated slow push-ins, eye level or slightly low, 35 mm, 50 mm and 85 mm spherical lenses
look.grade: warm skin tones, teal-blue shadows, soft highlight roll-off, gentle contrast, no crushed blacks
look.texture: fine 35 mm grain, slight halation around the string lights
look.ambience: wedding reception murmur, glasses clinking, distant laughter, soft room tone of a glass conservatory
look.avoid: slow motion, dutch angles, lens flares across faces, sharp faces in the background crowd, anyone looking into the lens

cast.name: Nora
cast.look: copper-red chin-length bob with a blunt fringe, freckles, green eyes, fair skin, slim, 1.68 m
cast.wardrobe: emerald-green satin slip dress, thin gold chain necklace with a small key pendant, small gold hoop earrings
cast.manner: sharp, guarded, funny when cornered; smiles with her mouth before her eyes

voice.direction: dry, quick, low; drops to a whisper when she is scared
voice.sample: [dryly] Oh, I'm fine. I'm always fine. [sighs] That's the problem.

cast.name: Theo
cast.look: tall, warm brown skin, short dark curly hair, short neat beard, dark brown eyes, 1.86 m
cast.wardrobe: charcoal suit, white shirt with an open collar, no tie, silver signet ring on the right hand
cast.manner: unbothered, amused, always half a step ahead; goes very still when he means it

voice.direction: warm, relaxed, close to the mic, a smile in the voice
voice.sample: [amused] Relax. Nobody here knows a thing about us. Yet.

cast.name: Celeste
cast.look: platinum-blonde low chignon, pale skin, sharp cheekbones, pale blue eyes, 1.72 m
cast.wardrobe: ivory wedding gown with long lace sleeves, pearl drop earrings, short veil pinned at the back of the chignon
cast.manner: bright and gracious in public, brittle underneath; her smile cracks at the corners

voice.direction: polished British, too sweet, venom when she lowers her voice
voice.sample: [sweetly] Darling, you look wonderful. [lower] Truly. Who would have thought.

locations.name: the glasshouse wedding reception
locations.description: a wedding reception at night inside a tall Victorian glass conservatory: round tables with white linen, candles and white peonies, warm string lights crossing overhead, a small dance floor and a long head table at the far end, dark garden beyond the glass walls

shots.action: Nora's eyes over the rim of a champagne flute, fixed on something across the room. Theo leans in behind her shoulder, soft focus, his mouth near her ear.
shots.overlay: SHE HIRED HIM FOR ONE NIGHT.

shots.action: Across the room, deep out of focus through string-light bokeh, a bride in white laughs on the dance floor with a man in a tuxedo.
Nora turns to Theo with a bright fake smile that never reaches her eyes, and speaks through her teeth.

lines.text: She married my fiancé. Tonight, you're mine.
lines.how: through a frozen smile, low and fast

shots.action: Theo, unbothered, lifts his glass an inch toward the dance floor and gives her a lazy half-smile, then takes a sip.

lines.text: Two hundred says she cries first.

shots.action: Celeste in her wedding gown glides toward camera between the round tables, arms open, the string lights behind her.

lines.how: bright, too sweet, a little too loud

shots.action: Nora rises halfway from her chair, champagne still in hand, her smile locked in place.
Celeste's eyes slide past Nora to the man beside her. Her smile cracks at the corners; she goes pale.
Theo, seated, calm, raises his glass to her.
Nora's eyes dart from Celeste to Theo and back. She does not breathe.
shots.silence: a held beat, only the room murmur

shots.action: Celeste bends close to Theo, smile still on for the guests, voice dropped so only they can hear.

lines.text: You swore you'd never come back.

shots.action: Nora turns her head slowly to Theo, stunned.
Theo keeps his eyes on Celeste. For the first time the smile is gone.

lines.text: I was supposed to marry her.

shots.action: Slow push-in on Nora as it lands: her lips part, then the corner of her mouth lifts. Celeste is a pale blur at the edge of frame.
shots.silence: no one speaks, the murmur of the room drops away

shots.action: Decision on Nora's face. She sets her champagne flute down on the linen, hard enough to slosh.

shots.move: slow arc of 30 degrees around them
shots.action: Nora stands, takes Theo's face in both hands and kisses him, slow and certain. Celeste stands soft-focus in the left foreground, frozen.
Celeste watches the kiss. The champagne in her glass trembles; she swallows and lifts her chin.
Nora pulls back an inch, breathless, eyes sliding sideways toward Celeste. Theo, still close, answers without looking away from Nora.
Celeste turns and walks away stiffly toward the dance floor, the veil trailing, guests parting for her.
Nora exhales a disbelieving laugh, still holding Theo's lapel.
Theo's smile fades. He holds her gaze, very still.

lines.text: I didn't answer your ad by accident.

shots.action: Nora's face, the laugh gone, eyes searching his. String-light bokeh. She does not blink.
shots.silence: a held look, room tone only

cues.intent: sly playful pizzicato pulse under the hook and the bet, tiptoes when the bride arrives
low tension under the twist, blooms into a warm string swell on the kiss at about 38 s, pulls back to a single piano line
one low sustained cello note with a soft riser, cut dead on the last frame
